name: lease-interpreter
description: The LLM-drafts-human-confirms workflow as a static page: build the extraction prompt, paste the draft back, resolve the flags, see the dollar spread, export lease-terms JSON. The AI reads; it never computes.

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/build-gate.mjs && node scripts/smoke-build.mjs
scripts.build:single: cross-env SINGLE_FILE=1 vite build && node scripts/finalize-single.mjs && node scripts/build-gate.mjs dist-single && node scripts/smoke-build.mjs dist-single
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
